author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತಿಲಕ ಭಸ್ಮಗಳಿಹವು ಮುದ್ರೆ ನಾಮಗಳುಂಟು
ಸಿಲುಕಿ ಮತ ಸುಳಿಯೊಳಗೆ ತೊಳಲದಿರು ನೀನು
ಕಲೆಸುತಲೆ ಒಳತಿರುಳ ಹೊರತೆಗೆಯೆ ತತ್ವಗುರಿ 
ಫಲವಹುದು ಶಾಂತಿ ಸುಖ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: There are tilaka and sacred ash, seals and nāma marks;
don’t get caught and flounder in the whirlpool of sects;
if you stir them and draw out the inner kernel, the goal of truth,
peace and happiness are the fruit, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Sectarian marks such as tilaka, bhasma and nāma are outer signs. Don’t get lost in sectarian quarrels; look for the shared essence beneath them, and peace follows.
